missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Жена' is nominative as the subject of 'работает'. 'Моя' is the agreeing feminine possessive, and 'в школе' is prepositional for location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Жену' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'. 'Свою' is the agreeing feminine reflexive possessive showing the wife belongs to the speaker.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Жены' is genitive after 'для' to mark the recipient. 'Подарок' stays nominative as the predicate noun being introduced.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Жене' is in the dative case as the indirect object of 'купил'. 'Красивые цветы' is the accusative direct object that was bought.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Женой' is instrumental, required by the verb 'гордится'. 'Своей' is the agreeing feminine reflexive possessive in the instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Жене' is the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic. 'Моей' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive in possession frame. 'Жены' is genitive after 'у' to show whose birthday it is. 'Сегодня' adds the time reference.

missions.phrase: Я иду в кино с женой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Женой' is instrumental after 'с' to mean together with. 'В кино' shows the destination.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Жёны' is the nominative plural subject, with the stem stress shift. 'Наши' is the agreeing plural possessive, and 'подруги' is the predicate.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Жена' is nominative as the doer of 'приготовила', which agrees in feminine gender. 'Вкусный ужин' is the accusative object.
